description: This file defines the implementation of an NL80211 client class used for WiFi driver communication within the prplMesh project. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and documentation related to WiFi interface management, station and radio info retrieval, and other network management functions.

classes.name: nl80211_client_impl
classes.description: Implementation of the nl80211_client interface for communication with WiFi drivers via NL80211 sockets. Provides methods for retrieving interface, radio, station info, and controlling WiFi features.

methods.name: nl80211_client_impl
methods.description: Constructor that takes ownership of a nl80211_socket for communication with the WiFi driver.

methods.name: get_interfaces
methods.description: Retrieves a list of wireless interface names.

methods.name: get_interface_info
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about a specified interface.

methods.name: get_radio_info
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific radio interface, including capabilities and supported channels.

methods.name: get_sta_info
methods.description: Gathers metrics for a station associated with the interface.

methods.name: get_survey_info
methods.description: Obtains survey data such as channel occupation and noise levels.

methods.name: set_tx_power_limit
methods.description: Sets the transmission power limit for a given radio interface.

methods.name: get_tx_power_dbm
methods.description: Retrieves the current transmission power setting.

methods.name: channel_scan_abort
methods.description: Stops an ongoing channel scan on the specified interface.

methods.name: add_key
methods.description: Adds an encryption key to an interface.

methods.name: add_station
methods.description: Manually adds a station with association request info and aid.

methods.name: get_key
methods.description: Retrieves security key information for an interface.

methods.name: send_delba
methods.description: Sends a DELBA frame to a station to disconnect or manage WMM/BA sessions.
